## DA Integration 2.0.5 for Minecraft 26.3 (Fabric)

Bugfix release on top of 2.0.4.

### Fixes

- Triggers that fire on donations now always match the ones in the menu after you save. Before, new triggers could fail to fire while removed or changed ones still did, because the settings file was sometimes read while it was still being written ([#19](https://github.com/bUmmy1337/da-integration/pull/19)).

### Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ for Minecraft 26.3 and Fabric API.
2. Replace the old mod jar in your `mods` folder with `daintegrate-2.0.5.jar`.

For everything new in 2.0, see the [2.0.1 release](https://github.com/bUmmy1337/da-integration/releases/tag/26.3_2.0.1).
